note.question: What determines a pricing and information provisioning game between a better-informed seller (such as a retailer) and its customers?
note.overview: This paper studies a pricing and information provisioning game between a better-informed seller (such as a retailer) and its customers. The seller is (ex post) better informed about product availability and can choose how to communicate this information to the customers. The customers are heterogeneous in their valuation for the product.
